newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal eases, some interbank rates dip.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal eases, some interbank rates dip.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal eased slightly despite a tight market, while some riyal interbank deposit rates lost around 1/16 point ahead of the Moslem Eid al-Fitr holiday marking the end of Ramadan, dealers in Saudi Arabia said.
The Eid is expected to start either on Saturday or Sunday.
They said the market was relatively active mainly on the short dates, which they put at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent for spot-next and 5-9/16, 7/16 percent for one-week maturity.
The spot riyal eased to 3.7505/07 to the dollar from 3.7504/06 last week.

One-month interbank deposits were quoted at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent and three months were at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent. Six months were at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent, or 1/16 point lower with some banks, and one-year rates were put at 5-15/16, 13/16 percent.
